errors.computeFailed: Could not compute incentives for this month.
errors.materializeFailed: Could not create the incentive adjustments.

intro: Sales incentive per counsellor, computed from revenue actually collected in a month — paid leads of converted enquiries, not pipeline. Set a commission percentage, a flat amount per conversion, or both; materializing writes a CRM_INCENTIVE adjustment that the payout month's regular payroll run pays.
commissionHint: Commission runs 0–{{max}}% of collected revenue; the fixed amount is paid once per paying lead. At least one of the two must be set, or every counsellor computes to nothing.

emptyTerms.title: Set a commission or a per-conversion amount
emptyTerms.description: Incentives are revenue × commission, plus a flat amount per conversion. With neither set there is nothing to compute.

nothingComputed.title: Nothing computed yet
nothingComputed.description: Preview reads every payment collected in {{month}} and attributes it to the counsellor who converted the lead. It is a heavy query, so it runs only when you ask for it.

noneToPay.title: No counsellor can be paid for this month
noneToPay.description: Nothing was collected in {{month}}, or every counsellor who collected is missing an employee record.

unlinkedHint: These people collected revenue but are not linked to an employee record — there is nobody to raise a payroll adjustment against, so materializing leaves them out. Their incentive is included in the total above so the number is honest.
payThisIncentiveHint: One CRM_INCENTIVE adjustment per linked counsellor, on the payout month's regular payroll run. Running it twice for the same payout period is safe — the second run creates nothing.
payoutSummary: {{earning}} incentive will be paid in the {{payout}} payroll run.
sameMonthWarning: Both months are the same — check that is what you meant.
